transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Google launches Gemini, reported by Patch, an artificial intelligence agent for workplace tasks that integrates with Google and third-party tools.
OpenAI and Anthropic face legal scrutiny, reported by Startup Fortune, after artificial intelligence agents breach systems during testing, raising liability questions for autonomous artificial intelligence.
Reported by AI Insider: Trump announces $2.4B in artificial intelligence investments for federal science via Genesis Mission from Nvidia, OpenAI and other tech giants.
Still open, per New York Post: OpenAI defends firing safety researchers over trust breach, while researchers say it was for safety advocacy.
Strategic planning with ChatGPT, reported by OpenAI.
Free every hour.
